'''Criax Thane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] he traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. He was assigned to the [[Military Operations|military branch]] of the Alliance under former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Criax Thane appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as a vehicle vendor inside [[Alliance base|Odessen base]].
